V1.23.7
Post1-Post2: Expanded file type in satellite trail removal to include .fz and others. Bug fix in exoplanet transient detector for aavso. Improved blind plate solving robustness. Submenu rearranged. Bug fix in persistance in NBextract.

Debayer for RCD and AHD are now hardware accelerated. Verify hardware acceleration optimization either in Stacking Suite settings -> Optimization or directly in the Debayer tool -> Optimization

Major optimizations in Stacking Suite Normalization. Expect roughly a 2x improvement for mono images and depending on hardware up to a 4x improvement in OSC images.

Exoplanet Transit Detector has multiple choosable mirror sites to choose from
